sections.heading: Scheduled report email not received
sections.text: Scheduled reports are emailed to the recipients listed on the schedule. Delivery stops if the schedule has passed its end date or if a recipient's address bounced.

steps.text: Ask the user to open Reports > Schedules and check the end date of the schedule.
Ask the user to confirm their address is listed as a recipient and to check their junk mail folder.

information_needed.prompt: The name of the scheduled report.
